summary: Customer handles a petroleum stream, currently uses laboratory water determination, and wants to investigate a fiber-based measurement closer to the process with the analyzer outside the process area, so changes can be noticed sooner. They ask what to clarify and what a first comparison experiment should establish before selecting equipment.
